author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜೇನು ಹೀರುವ ಕೀಟದೊಡನಾಟ ಹುವೊಡನೆ
ಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳ ಸಂಗವಹು ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯೆ
ದೀನಹೀನತೆ ಸರಿಸಿ ಸಜ್ಜನರ ಸಂಗ ಪಡೆ
ಆನುತಿರು ಸಜ್ಜನಿಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The bee that sips honey keeps company with flowers;
to gain light, keep company with the wise;
push aside meanness and misery, seek the company of the good,
and keep leaning on goodness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: As the bee finds honey among flowers, we find light among wise people. Leave pettiness behind and stay close to the good.
